criteria: Cosmetic, internal or nice to have; no deadline
Affects customers or a known deadline, but is not blocking anyone today

priority._comment: ordinal: adjacent-level splits are expected (min_conf low); splits across non-adjacent levels go to a human. A work item filed at priority 1 that the model would lower goes to a person

critical_bug._comment: safety net: a work item that states customers/production are broken right now is P1 whatever the model scores, as is Severity '1 - Critical'. Verbs are anchored (できない/クラッシュする/...) and English words need a word boundary, so a noun like クラッシュレポート or Crashlytics does not hit. exclude_sentence: an improvement / design / docs / FAQ / postmortem / request sentence that merely names a failure is left to the model (no). exclude (field scope): test-env wording next to a production cue goes to a person (mixed). Left to the model on purpose: data inconsistency, security vulnerability reports, a bare '画面が真っ白' (no scope or no 'now'). "when": only a Bug / Issue / Incident-like item, or one with no type, is eligible; Epic, Feature, Task, Test Case, User Story ... are left to the readiness check and the model.
